name: GOLDEN SHEAVES
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of I’ve Found a Friend set to GOLDEN SHEAVES (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/Ive_Found_a_Friend/, second score, Ive_Found_a_Friend_2.xml, whose rights line reads “MUSIC: “Golden Sheaves”; Arthur S. Sullivan, pub.1874. Public Domain.”); only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Timeless Truths has no page for To Thee, O Lord, Our Hearts We Raise, so the tune was taken from the other words it sets. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit 53554 32112 34671 (https://hymnary.org/tune/golden_sheaves_sullivan). The tempo follows the crotchet = 92 that Hymns Ancient and Modern (Hymn 384, https://archive.org/details/hymnsanci00chur) prints over it. No hand fixes. Sullivan's dates (1842–1900) and the year 1874 are from the hymnary.org tune page.
